description.zh:
下一个查询开始Token，用来返回更多结果。
>第一次查询不需要提供本参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的NextToken值以继续查询。
description.en:
The token used to start the next query to retrieve more results.

> This parameter is not required in the first query. If not all results are returned in one query, you can pass in the NextToken value returned in the previous query to perform the query again.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~61933~~)接口查询。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the resource group.
The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-tags --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-group-id dds-bp17e7a049600000 --next-token 212db860000 --region cn-hangzhou
